set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "=== STEP 1: install aide ==="
sudo -n dnf install -y aide

echo "=== STEP 2: configure aide.conf for /etc coverage ==="
sudo -n test -f /etc/aide.conf && echo "aide.conf present"
if ! grep -q '^/etc[[:space:]]' /etc/aide.conf 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/aide.conf >/dev/null
  echo "# Full integrity baseline coverage for /etc (added for baseline task)" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/aide.conf >/dev/null
  echo "/etc FIPSR" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/aide.conf >/dev/null
fi
grep -n '^/etc' /etc/aide.conf

echo "=== STEP 3: initialize aide database ==="
sudo -n aide --init --config=/etc/aide.conf

echo "=== STEP 4: activate baseline db ==="
sudo -n ls -la /var/lib/aide/
sudo -n cp /var/lib/aide/aide.db.new.gz /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz
sudo -n ls -la /var/lib/aide/

echo "=== STEP 5: record baseline metadata ==="
sudo -n sha256sum /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz | sudo -n tee /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz.sha256 >/dev/null
date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ" | sudo -n tee /var/lib/aide/baseline-established-at.txt >/dev/null
cat /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz.sha256
cat /var/lib/aide/baseline-established-at.txt

echo "=== STEP 6: verify baseline runs clean (no diffs against itself) ==="
sudo -n aide --check --config=/etc/aide.conf > /tmp/aide-check-baseline.log 2>&1; rc=$?
echo "aide --check exit code: $rc"
tail -n 40 /tmp/aide-check-baseline.log

echo "=== DONE ==="
